description: Defines enums, structs, and request/response types for IPC communication in a macOS application, including capabilities, canvas geometry, notifications, and various request types.

classes.name: CanvasPlacement
classes.description: Optional placement hints for positioning a canvas panel in screen coordinates.

classes.name: CanvasShowResult
classes.description: Contains details about the result of showing a canvas, including directory, target, status, and URL.

methods.description: Decodes data into Request enum cases from a Codable format.
